quality.numeric_confidence_policy: Secondary reproduction explicitly attributed to Environment Agency Pollution Inventory 2024 is capped at confidence 98 until a direct official raw PI row is read.
quality.direct_source_result: Official catalog and ZIP path were revalidated, but the available web/binary clients did not yield row-level 2024 PI data; no confidence upgrade is claimed.
quality.no_data_policy: Missing explicit PI data is NO_DATA_CONTINUE, never zero.
quality.apr_policy: APR values are crosschecks only and are never silently substituted for PI rows.
quality.year_policy: Only explicit calendar-year 2024 Air annual-mass rows are promoted.

official_source_paths.retrieval: Official 2024 PI ZIP path is exposed by the EA catalog. Bounded web/container retrieval did not return a parseable row-level payload; the identical failure was not loop-retried and direct rows remain zero.
